idea-plugin.name: Hytale Project Setup
idea-plugin.description:
Ready-to-run Hytale mod projects, straight from the project wizard.

  • No local Hytale install required
  • Shadow JAR packaging preconfigured
  • Dev server built in, runs from the IDE
  • Clean Gradle setup — no commands needed
  • Java and Kotlin, with optional template config

File → New → Project → Hytale

Not affiliated with Hypixel Studios.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Expanded compatibility to additional JetBrains IDEs.
  • Removed the Java plugin dependency from the project wizard.
